policy: A source is educational context. An expert view is dated opinion. Neither changes indicators, execution, risk, model weights, orders or promotion without measured validation.

sources.title: Trading and Exchanges: Market Microstructure for Practitioners
sources.lesson: Orders, liquidity provision and trading costs belong in the same execution analysis.
sources.research_translation: Add quote, auction and broker-fill data before validating an execution policy.

sources.title: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets
sources.lesson: Trend, chart and intermarket methods provide explicit candidate descriptions; each still needs a cost-aware test.
sources.research_translation: Expose each indicator and its conflicts; do not assume a chart label predicts returns.

sources.title: Algorithmic Trading: Winning Strategies and Their Rationale
sources.lesson: Mean reversion and momentum are different strategy families with implementation assumptions.
sources.research_translation: Specify a rationale, holding horizon and executable return before testing one family.

sources.title: Evidence-Based Technical Analysis
sources.lesson: Objective, falsifiable rules and statistical inference are necessary for evaluating technical claims.
sources.research_translation: Freeze a single rule and preserve rejected results instead of selecting charts after the outcome.

sources.title: Advances in Financial Machine Learning
sources.lesson: Financial data and dependent labels require finance-specific model validation.
sources.research_translation: Version labels and inputs; separate model selection from genuinely unseen confirmation.

sources.title: Adaptive Markets: Financial Evolution at the Speed of Thought
sources.lesson: Market behavior can change as participants and environments change.
sources.research_translation: Treat regime conditioning as a separately frozen hypothesis with enough observations per regime.

sources.title: Active Portfolio Management, Second Edition
sources.authors: Richard C. Grinold and Ronald N. Kahn
sources.lesson: Benchmark-relative performance, residual risk and turnover belong in portfolio evaluation.
sources.research_translation: Measure correlated exposure and costs rather than adding independent single-name backtests.

sources.title: Expectations Investing: Reading Stock Prices for Better Returns, Revised and Updated
sources.authors: Michael J. Mauboussin and Alfred Rappaport
sources.lesson: Stock prices can be analyzed through the future business expectations they imply.
sources.research_translation: Require timestamped filings and contemporaneous expectations before constructing valuation features.

sources.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
sources.authors: Rama Cont, Arseniy Kukanov and Sasha Stoikov
sources.lesson: In the studied US stocks, short-horizon price changes relate to order-flow imbalance and depth.
sources.research_translation: Requires actual order-book events; daily volume is not a replacement for order-flow imbalance.

sources.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.authors: David H. Bailey, Jonathan Borwein, Marcos Lopez de Prado and Qiji Jim Zhu
sources.lesson: Selection across backtests can produce unreliable apparent out-of-sample winners.
sources.research_translation: Record all attempted specifications and keep future confirmation untouched; no search on these diagnostics.

sources.title: Fact, Fiction and Momentum Investing
sources.authors: Cliff Asness, Andrea Frazzini, Ronen Israel and Tobias Moskowitz
sources.lesson: Momentum research addresses a specified strategy and horizon, not every momentum oscillator.
sources.research_translation: Distinguish intermediate-horizon cross-sectional momentum from the bot's short-term RSI or SMA conditions.

sources.title: Sea Change
sources.lesson: The memo argues that a changed rate environment can alter investment opportunity and risk.
sources.research_translation: Store as dated expert opinion; never convert the author's authority into a numeric buy/sell input.

sources.title: Valuation Online and Accounting Resources
sources.lesson: Accounting and valuation require structured interpretation of financial statements.
sources.research_translation: Add filing-availability timestamps, accounting definitions and revision handling before valuation signals.

sources.title: NYSE Holidays and Trading Hours
sources.lesson: NYSE sessions include holidays and early closes.
sources.research_translation: Use a versioned exchange calendar; calendar-day or 24/7 assumptions are not valid stock session rules.

sources.title: NYSE Trading Information: LULD and Market-Wide Circuit Breakers
sources.lesson: Price bands and trading halts can interrupt ordinary order execution.
sources.research_translation: Collect timestamped halt and band states; missing state must not be inferred from a price bar.

sources.title: Shortening the Securities Transaction Settlement Cycle
sources.lesson: Most covered securities transactions have a standard one-business-day settlement cycle.
sources.research_translation: Reconcile available cash and settlement dates with the broker before allowing a cash-account order.
